body.statement:
For every pair of integers \(N\geq1\) and \(g\geq0\), the joint orientation frontier attains its spanning-tree bound exactly if and only if
\[
 \vartheta_{N,g}=2^g
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad
 N\geq2g+1.
\]
body.proof_tex:
The forward implication in the displayed equivalence is proved by the deleted-incidence argument below, and the reverse implication is the triangle-bouquet construction in \(\mathrm{lem:joint\mbox{-}orientation\mbox{-}frontier}\). For \(g=0\), the definition assumes \(N\geq1=2g+1\), while the one-vertex graph and the universal bound give \(\vartheta_{N,0}=1\).

Let \(g\geq1\) and suppose \(\vartheta_{N,g}=2^g\). By finiteness and the bound in \(\mathrm{lem:joint\mbox{-}orientation\mbox{-}frontier}\), an attaining pair \((H,r)\) must have cyclomatic number exactly \(g\), and restriction to the cotree of any spanning tree \(S\) bijects its score fiber with all \(2^g\) cotree orientations. Indeed, restriction is injective because successive leaf deletion uniquely determines any compatible orientation of \(S\).

Delete one row from the oriented incidence matrix of \(S\), call the resulting invertible matrix \(Q\), and let \(C\) be the reduced incidence matrix of the cotree. If \(x\in\{0,1\}^g\) records the cotree orientations and \(y\) the tree orientations, the prescribed-indegree equations give
\[
 y(x)=Q^{-1}\beta-Q^{-1}Cx.
\]
For a cotree edge \(f_j\), the corresponding column of \(Q^{-1}C\) is the signed unit flow along the unique tree path \(P_j\) joining its endpoints. Hence every coordinate of \(y\) is affine on the full Boolean cube, with a coefficient of absolute value one for precisely those \(j\) whose path \(P_j\) uses that tree edge. Since all cotree choices extend, each such affine coordinate is always in \(\{0,1\}\). Its range diameter equals the sum of the absolute values of its coefficients and is at most one. Thus \(P_1,\ldots,P_g\) are pairwise edge-disjoint. Simplicity forces \(|P_j|\geq2\), because a length-one path would duplicate \(f_j\). Therefore
\[
 N-1\geq |E(S)|\geq\sum_{j=1}^g|P_j|\geq2g,
\]
which gives \(N\geq2g+1\). This proves necessity and completes the equivalence.
